name: race_state_oracle
description: State-only US 1.1 reference route. It enters Ancient Lake through the same one-player Tracks path in both runners, holds throttle, and applies the established short-left-pulse line through a real lap. The native arm uses Original two-field gameplay cadence and proportionally scaled input frames; Enhanced one-field simulation remains a separate product-policy arm and is not scored here. The comparison joins native and real-ROM racer state on the in-game lap clock, not presentation frames. No PPMs are captured.

threshold_basis.state_max_position_p95: The strict independent-runner contract this lane exists to hold open. docs/ORACLE.md records the arms as expected-red: the reference replay moves the first five-unit separation from race clock 18 to 767 and still drifts, and that stays visible rather than tolerated.
threshold_basis.state_max_position_error: Held at the same five world units as the p95 for the same reason: this lane reports the divergence, it does not absorb it.
threshold_basis.state_min_progress_agreement: The strict contract; the reference replay already matches the ROM's checkpoint clocks exactly through checkpoints 0-3 (3, 349, 463, 707).
threshold_basis.state_min_rng_agreement: UNMEASURED: no recorded rng agreement exists for this lane. The comparison still fails closed when either trace carries no non-zero seed, which is the way this measurement can go vacuous.
threshold_basis.state_max_velocity_ratio_deviation: Carried over from the Bluey 2 lane, whose passing arm measured a 0.065% mean-object-speed deviation (docs/BLUEY2_PARITY.md); the same 2% band rejects a one-field cadence, which measured 13.98%.

reference_replay.basis: The first completed positive race state is ares frame 3449 / framebuffer serial 1417 at clock 3 and native frame 1559 at clock 3. The native queue publishes the scheduled field width one tick before that completed-state probe, while the tick-indexed input is committed at frame 1559. The one-tick field phase is confirmed at the first 3-to-2 transition: both runners reach clock 128.

ares_phase_offsets.basis: Measured first positive race clock: native frame 3118, ares approximately 3446. The title delta predicts 3324, leaving a +122 in-race phase offset.
